findings.title: 2 ms step-ambiguity window depends on timer latency; justification (2048-descriptor backlog) is wrong
findings.fix: Dext-side classification: AvbRxSlot.clock_gen (u32 at 40, from pad1) + AVB_RXF_TS_STEP_AMBIG (bit 3) on slots harvested from the step through the first tick starting >= 100 us after the SYSTIM write; AvbShmHeader.clock_gen (u32 at 896, from reserved) incremented by SetClock/StepClock; daemon uses slot.clock_gen/AMBIG instead of harvest_mach windows; update static_asserts, Rust mirror and tests (simulated 5 ms tick delay). Alternative: adaptive window from observed worst tick gap plus wait for last_tick_mach > step_end + window.

findings.title: ACMP listener SM: Talker Failed already registered on entry to SETTLED_NO_RSV declares nothing; TA change in SETTLED_RSV_OK conflicts with §8.2
findings.fix: Talker Failed row event becomes 'registered (or already registered on entry, no TA)' with the same action (Asking Failed + A-5 classification); add row SETTLED_RSV_OK | TA attributes changed | SETTLED_RSV_OK | apply §8.2 comparison/effective values/SetStreamFilter, Ready stays declared; tests per row.

findings.title: ACQUIRE SetClock drops asCapable and bounces servo through HOLDOVER because the pre-SetClock NRR is not held
findings.fix: Hold the last same-generation NRR across SetClock exactly as across StepClock (NRR is offset-invariant); test asCapable stays true across ACQUIRE.

findings.title: syncEvent correctionField source unspecified
findings.fix: syncEvent = preciseOriginTimestamp + (FU.correctionField + Sync.correctionField)·2^-16 ns + delay_comp·rateRatio/NRR_systim; vector with non-zero Sync correction.

findings.title: Held step can delay Pdelay_Resp up to 20 ms, past the stated 3 ms worst case / 10 ms bound
findings.fix: Drop a held Pdelay_Resp if now − t2 > 8 ms (count pdelay_resp_late_drop), or let Pdelay_Resp go out before the held step (its Follow_Up is skipped by the existing rule).

findings.title: Shared-memory seqlock clock block not specified as atomic fields (Rust data race)
findings.fix: Fields as AtomicU64 (f64 bits)/AtomicU32 with seq odd → fence(Release) → relaxed stores → seq even (Release); reader Acquire seq → relaxed loads → fence(Acquire) → re-check.

findings.title: No writer named for AVB_FLAG_OWNED / AVB_FLAG_RINGS_ATTACHED
findings.fix: RingAttach setFlags(set both); RingDetach/ClientGone setFlags(clear both) before releasing rxMem.

findings.title: last_available_index update rule missing
findings.fix: Update last_available_index on every ENTITY_AVAILABLE from the talker in every state; initialize from the ADP table at BIND_RX.
